narrative.overview:
The Kinetic Digital Lab is an engineered design environment calibrated for high-growth commercial impact. The visual language marries the tactile authority of an editorial broadsheet with the surgical responsiveness of a modern digital operations console. Clean architectural structures balance two distinct canvases: an obsidian dark void (#111318) alongside a warm cream background (#F7F6F2).

The atmosphere is sophisticated, calculated, and architectural. Rather than relying on generic corporate stock visuals or trendy gradient blobs, the system projects quiet authority through tight typographic geometry, micro-spaced monospace metadata badges, and high-frequency electric accents (#7657FF Editorial Indigo and #D9FF70 Neon Citrus).
keyCharacteristics: Calculated Dual Canvas: High-contrast interplay between obsidian dark modules and warm tactile paper foundations.
Architectural Typography: Expressive geometric display headings paired with high-legibility sans body and industrial monospace indicators.
Sculpted Tonal Layering: Interfaces remain flat and calm at rest, igniting diffuse radiant ambient glows strictly upon interaction.
Engineering Rigor: Hairline precision dividers, sub-second responsive physics, and zero decorative noise.

rules.name: The Dual-Canvas Rule
rules.body: Dark obsidian surfaces (#111318) and warm paper surfaces (#F7F6F2) may co-exist across the page flow, but individual components must strictly adhere to their native container's tonal contract.

rules.name: The 10% High-Voltage Rule
rules.body: Neon Citrus (#D9FF70) is a precision surgical instrument, never a wallpaper. It must occupy no more than 10% of any given viewport, strictly reserved for key conversion buttons, high-impact statistics, or live status pills.

rules.name: The Monospace Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every major section title and feature block must be introduced by an uppercase IBM Plex Mono eyebrow tag (e.g. // 01 / SERVICES, // ADMIN / CONSOLE).

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces and cards are completely flat at rest, bounded purely by 1px hairline borders. Elevation manifests solely as a reactive state (hover, focus, or modal overlay).

dos: Do wrap all section headings with an uppercase monospace eyebrow tag (IBM Plex Mono).
Do enforce border-radius: 9999px (pill) on all interactive buttons and chip toggles.
Do preserve 1px hairline borders (#303139 or #E5E4E0) around cards and container boundaries.
Do limit Neon Citrus (#D9FF70) to high-priority conversion signals and stat callouts.
Do ensure all interactive elements display visible focus outlines (2px solid #7657FF, outline-offset: 3px).
donts: Don't use generic unbranded blue (#0000FF) or plain red/green without system-aligned hex values.
Don't add heavy drop-shadows to resting cards; maintain flat-at-rest discipline.
Don't use pastel blob illustrations or stock SaaS vector art.
Don't mix low-contrast gray text on dark backgrounds; maintain minimum WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).
Don't alter button border thickness on focus (prevents layout reflow).
